_comment: Per-provider quirks for the OpenAI-compatible client, matched by base_url (fields documented in providers.py). Any endpoint with no entry here gets the portable default: bare model name, no extra headers, no reasoning remap. Override or extend via MIRA_PROVIDERS_JSON_PATH.

_fields.label: Display name for the dashboard (the Connections page and the line under each model picker).
_fields.description: One sentence for the Connections page card.
_fields.docs_url: Where the provider documents its API and plans.
_fields.base_url: The endpoint this profile applies to; `llm.base_url` is matched against it. `llm.provider: <name>` fills it in.
_fields.api_key_env: Environment variable holding the key, used when `llm.api_key_env` is unset or its variable is empty.
_fields.model_prefix: 'keep' sends the full vendor/model id (OpenRouter routes on it); 'strip' sends the bare model name.
_fields.extra_headers: Headers added to every request (attribution, client identification).
_fields.reasoning_effort_map: Renames for the unified reasoning.effort levels this endpoint spells differently.
_fields.session_header: Optional header carrying a stable per-conversation id (one per client instance, so one per review pass), for endpoints that route and cache by it.
_fields.usage_url: Optional GET endpoint reporting the key's allowance. Its document is read by the parser named in usage_format.
_fields.usage_format: Which parser reads usage_url's document (see mira.llm.key_providers). Currently: 'opencode-go'.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.description: Pay-per-token access to Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek and more behind one key.

opencode-go.label: OpenCode Go
opencode-go.description: OpenCode's $10/month subscription to open coding models (Kimi, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, MiniMax and more), metered in 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows.
